summary: Urgent hardware recall: loading-dock access denied prevented secure pickup of recalled laptops and encrypted SSDs (London campus)
description: Issue summary: Security issued an urgent hardware recall for a small batch of devices with a firmware vulnerability. Facilities scheduled an escorted secure courier pickup at Dock B (London campus) during an evening window. When the courier arrived the dock badge reader rejected the on-site escort badge (revoked by relocation automation) and the packing manifest did not match scanned assets in staging. Impact: 12 devices (7 laptops, 5 encrypted SSDs) were unable to be moved into secure chain-of-custody until escorted pickup could be arranged. No customer-facing impact but extended internal security exposure window.
steps_to_reproduce: Create recall manifest and schedule third-party secure courier for after-hours pickup.
Courier arrives at loading dock and attempts to badge in; system returns Access Denied for escort badge.
Courier verifies manifest and requests escort signature; on-site contact confirms badge deprovisioned during relocation cleanup.
Handheld scans show only partial match with manifest; courier refuses to accept partial sealed encrypted drives without verified escort.

comments: Maya Chen (2026-03-10): Raised this ticket after Security advisory A-2026-0310 required immediate recall. Facilities coordinated pickup but encountered access and manifest mismatches. Escalating to Security and Onsite Ops.

Diego Vargas (2026-03-10): En route to Dock B. Preliminary: relocation-cleanup automation revoked the escort user's temporary access yesterday. Will request time-limited escort badge from Building Security.
Emma R. (Onsite) (2026-03-10): Confirmed I no longer have dock access; HR marked relocation. I can be present tomorrow morning but not tonight. Can Facilities re-issue one-night escort badge?

James L. (Building Security) (2026-03-10): Can provide an escorted security officer for tonight with time-limited badge; will require confirmation from Facilities and a manifest reconciliation before escorting courier.
investigation_notes: Access lookup: temporary badges tied to relocated staff were not migrated to new access group; revoke timestamp 2026-03-09T08:03 by automation 'relocation-cleanup'.
CCTV review: footage confirms courier arrival 19:15-19:40 and waiting in loading bay; clip uploaded to secure storage.
Inventory reconciliation: handheld scans returned 10/12 expected tags; two tags (RWI-LAP-2232, RWI-SSD-111) missing from staging scan output. Possible packing omission or tag swap.
ArgoSecure policy: will not accept sealed encrypted SSDs without verified escort signature or fully matching manifest; partial pickups require additional authorizations.
resolution: Workaround executed: Building Security issued a time-limited escort badge (escort-INT-80123) and assigned Officer James L. to escort courier at 20:05. Couriers were able to collect the 10 scanned devices immediately; Facilities performed a rapid sweep and located the remaining 2 devices in the adjacent staging room; manifest updated and sealed. Final pickup completed 2026-03-10T20:48. Follow-up actions: update secure-recall runbook to include pre-check of relocation-access groups before scheduling after-hours pickups; schedule a full barcode audit for devices processed in last 30 recalls; modify relocation-cleanup automation to detect scheduled recall windows and pause revocation or raise an exception ticket. Owner: Diego Vargas.
